missing.en: It has not been confirmed by available materials whether all of the extant reliefs of the Twelve Labors are ancient originals or how much has been assembled through modern restoration; the scoring rationale emphasizes the monumental scale and narrative impact of a “complete cycle of reliefs of the Twelve Labors of Hercules,” and if the actual preservation is incomplete or the proportion of modern additions is high, its artistic impact and whether it merits a special visit will be significantly affected.
